chapter: Western University and Kansas City nightlife
title: Organizing a band at Western University
summary: He quickly formed a band with Buddy Anderson and Frog, buying stock arrangements like 'White Heat'.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And on the side I started right away to gettin' music jobs. In fact, I don't know how they even knew I was in town. When I first got in town, naturally I went over to all those famous places in Missouri. And I saw Herschel (phonetic). And, by the way, he played that track on me. I said right to this day, I can't forget him. It was cold. And as soon as I got in town, I kinda' organized this band. I think I had fifteen pieces in it. Buddy Anderson and Frog were in my band.
What do you mean, you organized a band when you got to town?
Well, when I got into Wesley University, I--
Oh, you organized a band in the university?
Yeah. I had a band there.
Oh, I got you this. Yeah.
Yeah. And, poor as we were, I think one piece of music I bought was "Out in the Cold Again." Remember that song?
Yeah. I don't remember the song; I remember the title.
And then later on, I bought "White Heat," Lunsford's "White Heat." And I had a thing by
Duke Ellington, but I can't remember [illegible], the name of it.
Well, these were stocks you bought, were they?
